say:2:1130317002:1.text: I was out hunting like usual, but when I caught a wild sandbeast, these Grimmaw scum slandered my name and said I stole their prey!
say:2:1130317002:1.source_cn: 我好端端地在外面打猎，好不容易捕获了一头野猪，结果这群...
say:2:1130317002:1.male: I was out hunting like usual, but when I caught a wild sandbeast, these Grimmaw scum slandered my name and said I stole their prey!
say:2:1130317002:1.female: I was out hunting like usual, but when I caught a wild sandbeast, these Grimmaw scum slandered my name and said I stole their prey!

say:3:1130317003:1.text: Before I knew it, they took my kill and threw me in this cage!
say:3:1130317003:1.source_cn: 紧接着他们就抢走了我的猎物，不仅如此，还把我带到这里关...
say:3:1130317003:1.male: Before I knew it, they took my kill and threw me in this cage!
say:3:1130317003:1.female: Before I knew it, they took my kill and threw me in this cage!

say:4:1130317004:1.text: It's insanity! Let me out of here!
say:4:1130317004:1.source_cn: 真是不讲理又粗暴！快点放我出去！
say:4:1130317004:1.male: It's insanity! Let me out of here!
say:4:1130317004:1.female: It's insanity! Let me out of here!
